code_snippet: if ws.max_row >= MAX_XLSX_ROWS or any(len(value) > MAX_XLSX_CELL_CHARS for value in values):
observed_behavior: Evaluating ws.max_row on every row inside `for values in rows:` causes openpyxl to scan all existing cells via `max(self._cells)[0]`, turning the loop into quadratic O(R^2).
